mLocKeys.keySummary: Kennen passively deals extra damage and adds a Mark of the Storm to his target every few attacks, and he can activate this ability to damage and add another Mark of the Storm to targets who are already marked.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip:
Passive: Every 5th Attack deals an additional @TotalDamagePassive@ magic damage %i:OnHit% On-Hit.

Active: Kennen sends out a blast of electricity, dealing @TotalDamageActive@ magic damage to nearby enemies affected by Mark of the Storm.
mLocKeys.keyTooltipExtendedBelowLine:
The passive also applies Mark of the Storm and can critically strike for @TotalDamagePassiveCrit@ instead.
Attacking structures will stack the passive, but not expend it. The active automatically hits enemies inside of Slicing Maelstrom.

mBuff.mDescription: <titleLeft>Electrical Surge @Stack@</titleLeft><mainText>Kennen will deal extra damage and add a Mark of the Storm to his opponent every 5 attacks.</mainText><postScriptLeft>Source: @SourceName@</postScriptLeft>
<titleLeft>Electrical Surge</titleLeft><mainText>Kennen's next attack will deal bonus damage and add a Mark of the Storm.</mainText><postScriptLeft>Source: @SourceName@</postScriptLeft>
<titleLeft>Electrical Surge</titleLeft><mainText>Kennen's next attack will deal bonus damage and add a Mark of the Storm.</mainText><postScriptLeft>Source: @SourceName@</postScriptLeft>

mLocKeys.keyTooltip: You can activate Lightning Rush again right now to cancel the current spell.

mBuff.mDescription: <titleLeft>Lightning Rush</titleLeft><mainText> Kennen cannot attack, but has increased Move Speed and damages any enemy he touches.</mainText><postScriptLeft>Source: @SourceName@</postScriptLeft>

mLocKeys.keySummary: Kennen morphs into a lightning form, enabling him to pass through units and apply a Mark of the Storm. Kennen gains Move Speed when entering this form, and attack speed when leaving it.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip:
Kennen turns into a ball of lightning, gaining @MovementSpeed*100@% Move Speed, dealing @TotalDamage@ magic damage to enemies he passes through, and becoming Ghosted for @DurationAsBall@ seconds. If Kennen damages at least one enemy, he gains @EnergyRefund@ Energy.

After this ability ends, Kennen gains @TotalAS*100@% Attack Speed for @DurationAfterBall@ seconds. Critical Strikes extend this duration by @CritDurationBonus@ second(s). Kennen can Recast to end this Ability early.
mLocKeys.keyTooltipExtendedBelowLine:
Ghosted units can pass through other units.
Deals @DamageToMinions*100@% damage to minions and jungle monsters.
Duration cannot be extended beyond its initial value.

mBuff.mDescription: <titleLeft>Lightning Rush</titleLeft><mainText> Kennen has bonus attack speed.</mainText><postScriptLeft>Source: @SourceName@</postScriptLeft>
<titleLeft>Mark of the Storm (@Stack@)</titleLeft><mainText> This unit will be stunned if it reaches 3 stacks of Mark of the Storm.</mainText><postScriptLeft>Source: @SourceName@</postScriptLeft>
<titleLeft>Lighting Struck</titleLeft><mainText>This unit will receive a reduced stun effect if stunned again by Mark of the Storm.</mainText><postScriptLeft>Source: @SourceName@</postScriptLeft>

mLocKeys.keySummary: Kennen stuns enemies he hits 3 times with his abilities.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip: Kennen's abilities apply a stack for @MarkDuration@ seconds. At 3 stacks, enemies are <status>Stunned</status> for @StunDuration@ seconds and Kennen gains <keywordMajor>@EnergyRestore@ Energy</keywordMajor>.
mLocKeys.keyTooltipExtended:
{{ Spell_KennenPassive_Tooltip }}
If an enemy is Stunned more than once by this ability within @DiminishingReturnDuration@ seconds, they are instead Stunned for @ReducedStunDuration@ seconds.

mLocKeys.keySummary: Kennen throws a fast moving shuriken towards a location, causing damage and adding a Mark of the Storm to any opponent that it hits.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip: Kennen throws a shuriken, dealing <magicDamage>@TotalDamage@ magic damage</magicDamage> to the first enemy hit.

mBuff.mDescription: <titleLeft>Shuriken Storm</titleLeft><mainText>Kennen has a storm surrounding him, dealing damage and adding a Mark of the Storm to all nearby enemies.</mainText><postScriptLeft>Source: @SourceName@</postScriptLeft>

mLocKeys.keySummary: Kennen summons a storm that strikes at nearby enemy champions for magical damage.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip: Kennen unleashes a magical storm, dealing <magicDamage>@PerTickDamageCalculated@ magic damage</magicDamage> to all nearby enemies every @KennenRTickRate@ seconds, and gaining <scaleArmor>@KennenRDefenses@ Armor</scaleArmor> and <scaleMR>@KennenRDefenses@ Magic Resist</scaleMR> for @KennenRDuration@ seconds. Successive hits deal @DamageAmp*100@% increased damage for each hit the enemy has already suffered.
mLocKeys.keyTooltipExtendedBelowLine: <rules>Enemies can only receive 3 stacks of <spellName>Mark of the Storm</spellName> from this ability.</rules>
